column3: “Repeated … to take up” is rendered “again took up.”
“Who will give me” is rendered “Oh that I were.”
“The days of my prime” is rendered “the prime of my days,” and “intimacy” as “friendship.”
“Chiefs” is rendered “princes,” and “restrained in words” as “stopped talking.”
“The case at law of the one whom I did not know” is rendered “the case which I did not know.”
“The unrighteous” is rendered “the wicked”; “threw” is rendered “snatched.”
“Said” is rendered “thought.” “Nest” may also be read “with my nest”; “sand” may mean “phoenix,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“I laughed to them” is rendered “I smiled on them.”
